samples.identity: RISC-V Linux HTTP flood bot with appliance propagation and DirtyFrag RxKAD exploit
evidence: 0x7fec formats oversized POST; 0x8016 sends the request with retry handling.
0x10bd8 passes the systemd unit path to a helper opening with flags 0x241 and writing its template.
0x1ffa6 formats Hikvision command-injection request; 0x1ffd0 dispatches it.
Embedded ELF at 0x5b508 contains setgid/setuid/setgroups and execve shellcode.
Section-name table contains invalid UTF-8; cleave cannot project sections or native symbols. Capstone RISC-V disassembly used after rizin lacked a RISC-V decoder.

samples.identity: Gutcheck 0.11 Windows performance and stability diagnostics PowerShell module
evidence: Manifest identifies MERLIN/kort3x Gutcheck and exposes Invoke-Gutcheck.
Module import defines functions; diagnostics run through the explicit public command.
Elevation uses visible RunAs UAC; session-switch task uses Limited interactive principal and is unregistered in finally.
Device flow posts only to Microsoft Entra token endpoints; Graph downloads data-defined checks. Check vocabulary is closed, with JSON parsing rather than arbitrary evaluation.
Reports are local HTML and CSV; optional retained OAuth tokens are DPAPI protected and expire.
Self-update uses PowerShell Gallery installation and explicit relaunch, not an unrelated payload.
